03 — Engagement models

Three ways to work with ZEHNOX.

No public pricing and no packages. Every engagement begins with a conversation and a scope, then a proposal written for it.

Model 01

Project

A defined scope with a defined finish. Discovery, proposal, build, and handover: one system, one film, one site, or one program, delivered, documented, and owned by your team.

Model 02

Retainer

Ongoing capacity for work that does not finish. Content produced to a cadence, automation extended workflow by workflow, and systems that keep evolving with the business.

Model 03

Ecosystem Partnership

For organizations working across several verticals at once, or alongside the STRATEGIC Ecosystem. A standing relationship with shared standards, shared talent, and one point of accountability.

Whichever model fits, the first step is the same: book a consultation, walk through the situation, and receive a proposal tailored to the engagement.
